agent.initial_generation: baseline-style task-only seed; references reserved for repair/review
agent.behavior_review: bounded source-grounded JSON checks after first successful synthesis; mismatch claims trigger separate targeted repair; not simulation
agent.review_modes: evidence (default), legacy (ablation), or AGENT_BEHAVIOR_REVIEW=0 to disable
agent.repair_output: exact-anchor edits or complete RTL; evidence review returns checks, not KEEP or rewritten RTL
agent.verification_cache: per-task exact source/stage/top; no reuse of transient failures
